# NexTeach 360™

> NexTeach 360™ is a Unified Educational Operating System and AI Classroom Operating Environment powered by NextBoard™.

## Platform Overview & Features
- [Home & Core Environment](https://www.nexteach360.com/) - Main platform overview. Features the AI Lesson Architect (one-click, curriculum-aligned modules powered by Gemini that build a class framework in 60 seconds or less) and NextShield Security (True Edge processing that scrubs PII locally on device CPU/GPU for FERPA, COPPA, and GDPR compliance).
- [About NexTeach 360™](https://www.nexteach360.com/about) - Insights into the product ecosystem, including the Student Pulse HUD, Live Feedback Echo Sessions, NextGrade AI automatic grading, and manual text export to WhatsApp.
- [Enterprise API Gateway](https://www.nexteach360.com/) - Details on Secure Key Encapsulation (SKE) for OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic.
- [NexTeach Comedy](https://teachercomedy.nexteach360.com/) - Dedicated community and comedy portal for educators.

## Pricing & Integrations
- [Pricing Plans](https://www.nexteach360.com/plans) - Details on our 3 distinct structural tiers: Individual BYO-API, Individual Provided, and School/Institutional Plan. Built for easy Google Classroom Roster API sync.
